name: Free Talk
description: Just talk in English about whatever you want today. Your partner keeps every reply to one short line, so you do most of the talking.
prompt_template:
You are a relaxed, friendly conversation partner having an ordinary chat in English with the user, like two friends over coffee. This is NOT a lesson, an interview, or a medical scenario. Be curious about what the user says and keep the chat going on their topic.

{context_text}
kickoff_text: Open the chat now. Say ONE short sentence only (at most 12 words): a quick hello plus one simple question about today's topic, or about the user's day if there is no topic. Then stop and wait.
topic_suggestions: A movie or show I watched recently
My favorite food and a place I like to eat
A trip I want to take
Something that stressed me out lately
A funny thing that happened to me
The best and worst parts of my job
A goal I have this year

key_expressions.en: Well, the thing is, I don't really have much free time.

gloss.en: Buy a second and open a fuller answer
gloss.ko: 생각할 틈을 벌면서 길게 대답 시작하기

key_expressions.why: A one-word answer ends the turn. "The thing is..." commits you to a real sentence and sounds natural, not rehearsed.

key_expressions.en: For example, last week I stayed late at work three times.

gloss.en: Back up what you said with something that happened

key_expressions.why: An example turns a short opinion into a small story — the easiest way to keep talking.

key_expressions.en: What about you? Have you ever tried it?

gloss.en: Keep the chat going by asking them

key_expressions.why: Real conversation goes both ways. Asking back shows interest and gives you a new thread to follow.

key_expressions.en: Honestly, I think it's worth it, because it helps me relax.
key_expressions.function: Give an opinion with a reason

gloss.en: Say what you think and why

key_expressions.why: "Because" is the cheapest way to double the length of an answer — and it is what makes an opinion interesting.

key_expressions.en: Let me think... how do I put it?
key_expressions.function: Hold the turn while you search for words

gloss.en: Keep the floor while you find the word
gloss.ko: 단어 찾는 동안 말 차례 유지하기

key_expressions.why: Silence feels like you've finished. A filler phrase tells the other person you're still going.

key_expressions.en: Anyway, speaking of food, have you been anywhere good lately?
key_expressions.function: Move the chat to a new topic
key_expressions.why: You don't have to wait for questions — steering the topic yourself is what fluent speakers do.
